newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not well tested, on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1275 lbs 118.00. Dressed Basis Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 118.00.
Slaughter steers and heifers were not established. Demand and seller interest light following weekly movement of 80,200.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Heifers - No confirmed sales. Confirmed - 300 Last Week - 1,900 Last Year - 300 Wk To Date - None. Sm Pd Lst Wk - None. Sm Pd Lst Yr- None.
